name: Jonathan Cocks
story: Jonathan Cocks of DSIR Crop Research at Lincoln proposed the in-camera radiometer used in PEL’s aircraft multispectral work. The 1976 Landsat report credits his idea for measuring target radiance during photographic surveys.
